The evidence explicitly describes an algorithm that iterates over all grid cells ('Iterate over all grid cells (i, j, k) from 0 to grid_size-1'). Since the primary computational cost in such grid-based methods is typically the iteration and the linear algebra operations for the relevant cells, the claim that the time complexity is dominated by these steps is fully supported by the provided procedural evidence.
